cross-reference.answer: I read §2002:9.1.6. A word diff with §2023:9.1.6 shows only the list of OTHER fixed attributes: 2002 has 'the padding character', and 2023 drops it and adds 'SUPPRESS WHEN attribute'. The sentence the item rests on ('The implementor shall specify whether the ability to share a physical file is a fixed file attribute') is identical, so the scope is unchanged.
